title: Chapter 481
text:
Tong tong tong!

"Don't dodge if you have the guts!"

Sherman's expression was ferocious. He held the giant gun with both hands and shot out thick beams of light that pierced through the walls of the building, chasing after Herlous.

"Cease fire if you have the guts!"

With a roar, Herlous dragged his Battleship Slicing Blade and used the buildings as cover to avoid Sherman's shots. He circled around Sherman in the complicated terrain of the battlefield.

After the battle broke out, Sherman immediately found Herlous as his opponent. He still remembered this mercenary who had injured him and was still holding a grudge.

The chaotic battle between DarkStar and the mercenaries had formed many small groups that were spread out in this area. Shouts, gunshots, and explosions could be heard from afar. The aftermath of the chaotic battle between the Supers had caused the destruction of this area to continue to increase, and flames could be seen everywhere.

Herlous was hit by Sherman a few times. This dwarf cannon master's attacks were very powerful, and he did not feel good. His Shattering Light armor was burnt black all over, so he continued to fight as he moved away from the main battlefield.

His opponent was an elite warrior of the Dark-star, who was also Grade B. Herlous had to focus on dealing with him and did not have time to care about anything else. He only remembered that the others had also encountered a strong enemy. Fausthod and Wilsander were fighting fiercely and were also far away from the battlefield. The three Volga brothers worked together and dealt with the Dark-star warriors on the main battlefield.

Fu Ding should be hiding with Sylvia, but the battle affected such a large area. Herlous could not help but worry that the two of them would not have anywhere to hide and would be targeted by the enemy.

Xiu!

A laser beam missed his shoulder and hit a building in the distance, causing an explosion. Herlous cursed in his mind, hurriedly focused, and dodged again.

This time, a hurricane swept over from afar. Herlous could not resist and was thrown dozens of meters away. From the corner of his eyes, he saw a figure a few hundred meters away being blown into the sky as well. It was Sherman, who was also attacked by the hurricane indiscriminately.

Looking up, they saw the Wind Demon Anur flying around in the sky at high speed, dragging a small hurricane that covered an area of one square kilometer behind him. Wherever he passed, the buildings and streets would be blown away by the wind pressure, as if they had been plowed.

The tall buildings that originally blocked his vision were almost all leveled, and his vision became much wider. He could clearly see Nagojin and Black Star fighting with Anur in the sky. As Anur was too fast, the two of them were in a tough battle.

Bang!

A Wind Pressure Cannon blasted Black Star far away, crashing into a building with a boom.

Herlous gripped his weapon tightly, jumped up, and ran toward Sherman. He wanted to help Han Xiao, but he had to finish off his current opponent, Sherman, as soon as possible.

…

"Hiss! My back! "

Han Xiao flew out of the hole in the building and gasped.

His armor was covered in damage, and the tactical screen showed the overall battle situation that Philip observed. It was a stalemate, but his attention was mainly on Anur. Looking at Wind Demon who was freely playing with Nagojin, he felt troubled.

"This guy is indeed a veteran high-level combatant of Dark-star. His ability is too difficult to deal with. We can't keep up with his speed, so we're in a passive position."

Han Xiao's expression was grave. There were dozens of mission objectives in the Grade A mission [Godora's Ally]. Most of them were to kill or capture various Dark-star members or battleships, and a certain number of missions had to be completed. Some of the missions with higher rewards were specific people, such as killing the only important member of Dark-star. Anur was one of the mission objectives.

The amount of reward represented the difficulty of the mission, and Anur's mission reward was ranked sixth among the dozens of missions in [Godora's Ally]. Being at the top meant that Anur was strong.

"Most of my normal combat methods are useless against him. He's very fast and can hide, so it's very difficult for my weapons to hit him. He doesn't even need to come into contact with us. As long as he passes by us, the wind pressure can attack us. Furthermore, he can control the wind pressure to form a shield, so his defense isn't bad. Nagojin's agility in the sky can't be compared to him. No matter how strong his punches and kicks are, it's useless if he can't hit him."

Han Xiao thought calmly as he fired. Anur's abilities were very comprehensive. Only a few of his abilities could deal with Anur, and the most effective one was naturally Ames' Character Summon Card, which could imprison Anur for more than ten seconds. It was very effective against this kind of speed type enemy, but it could only be used once, so it was very precious. Even if he wanted to use it, Han Xiao would have to wait for a good opportunity.

Perhaps Chen Xing's Character Summon Card could also come in handy? Hui Mou Yi Xiao tempting the enemy and so on …

While he was observing the other party, Anur was also observing Han Xiao.

"Is he Black Star …"

Anur's gaze was scrutinizing. This was actually the first time he had seen Han Xiao with his own eyes. In the past, he had understood Black Star from the intelligence reports and Ashes's narrations. He was still somewhat curious about this guy who had repeatedly made Ashes suffer.

He did not understand why Ashes always suffered in the hands of Black Star, as if he was a stumbling block for Ashes.

The organization cultivated Ashes in order to let him play a more important role. Ashes' ability could accurately, quickly, and kill creatures on a large scale without destroying other objects — this was an important weapon to kill all of Godora's pure-blooded breeds, and the weapon could not be malfunctioned.

When Dark-star discovered the talent that Ashes displayed when he was young, they decided to turn him into a strategic killing weapon that belonged to Dark-star!

Letting Han Xiao live would affect Ashes' mentality, and now it had already hindered Dark-star's interests. Coincidentally, Anur felt that it was just right for him to get rid of Black Star, so that Ashes would not keep thinking about this mercenary.

"If that good-for-nothing student of mine can't do it, then let me get rid of you …" Anur thought to himself.

Rumble —

At this moment, the earth suddenly trembled.

Within a range of tens of kilometers, a large number of cracks appeared on the ground of the city, exposing the underground mechanical foundations. The buildings that were still intact sank into the ground and were protected. At the edge of this area, twenty-meter-tall mechanical pillars extended from the ground, forming a huge circle.

Hum —

These mechanical pillars lit up at the same time, and a huge sky-blue spherical shield quickly formed. Like an inverted bowl, it covered this circular area with a diameter of more than twenty kilometers, isolating everyone fighting inside from the rest of the city.

Every city had a large number of devices set up underground. This was an isolation shield. Noriose had taken the action of minimizing losses, restricting the battle to this area that was no longer worth saving, preventing the battlefield from moving. This was to protect the rest of the city.

This move was equivalent to giving up this area, but compared to a city that was thousands of square kilometers in size, this was a sacrifice to save the king.

If it was an ordinary troublemaker, they would definitely be arrested, but a fight between Calamity Grade Supers was not so easy to stop. Noriose only had one Grade A Guardian, and he was hired with an astronomical salary. One person alone might not be able to stop this battle.

Forcefully interfering would only increase their losses, and this group of people had a strong background.

Help Godora? Although Noriose was not afraid of Dark-star, they were businessmen and did not want to be targeted by such a terrorist organization.

Help Dark-star? Only a fool would do such a thing!

Therefore, the upper echelons of the financial group were also helpless. They were not the government but the managers of this planet. Their only goal was profit. If the cost of maintaining law and order was too high, they could consider watching from the sidelines. It had been many years since Grade A Supers fought in Noriose. The commotion caused by Dark-star was the biggest one in more than a decade.

The upper echelons of the financial group felt that in such a situation, staying out of it would be safer.

—
